intro: Welcome to Puppet Tales! Pick a story, dress your puppets, and make a show with your own voice.
guided: Story Starters. Pick a picture, then tell the beginning, middle, and ending.
free: Free Show. Pick your puppets and make up any story you like.
shows: My Shows. Your stories stay right here on this tablet.
pickStory: Pick a story to act out.
pickStage: Choose a stage and add something fun to wear or hold.
ready: Your stage is ready. Tap the red circle when you are ready to tell your story.
micOkay: Your voice stays on this tablet.
micNo: The microphone is resting. Your puppet moves will still be saved.
nextBeat: Wonderful. Here comes the next part.
saved: Your puppet show is saved on this tablet!
shelfFull: Your show shelf is full. Erase one old show before saving another.
story.forest-rescue.beginning: Once upon a time, two friends found tiny footprints in the forest. Who made them?
story.forest-rescue.middle: Then they heard a little cry across the stream. Show how the friends helped.
story.forest-rescue.ending: At last, everyone was safe. How does your forest story end?
story.moon-surprise.beginning: Once upon a time, two friends found a glowing map to the moon.
story.moon-surprise.middle: Then a little star needed their help. What did the friends do?
story.moon-surprise.ending: At last, the moon began to sparkle. How does your space story end?
story.royal-picnic.beginning: Once upon a time, two friends prepared a royal picnic.
story.royal-picnic.middle: Then a gust of wind sent everything flying. Show what happened next.
story.royal-picnic.ending: At last, everyone helped. How does your picnic story end?
story.three-little-pigs.beginning: The three little pigs each built a house. Show what they used.
story.three-little-pigs.middle: Then the wolf huffed and puffed. What happened to the houses?
story.three-little-pigs.ending: The brick house stayed strong. How does your pig story end?
story.goldilocks.beginning: Goldilocks found a little cottage in the woods. Who lived there?
story.goldilocks.middle: She tried the porridge, chairs, and beds. Show what happened.
story.goldilocks.ending: Then the bear family came home. How does your gentle Goldilocks story end?
story.little-red.beginning: Little Red carried a basket through the woods to Grandma's house.
story.little-red.middle: Then she met a tricky wolf on the path. What did she do?
story.little-red.ending: At last, Little Red reached Grandma safely. How does your story end?
